links.comparator_used: Baseline prompt and structurally modified setups (session-isolated, structured-input) without prompt refinement
links.outcome: De-identification F1-score on synthetic German discharge letters (GraSCCo)
links.effect: F1 0.93 for the optimized prompt (GPT-4o) vs 0.81 session-isolated and 0.79 structured-input; the baseline setup was unsuitable due to excessive text loss; GPT-OSS with the optimized prompt reached 0.90
links.quote: Results indicate that prompt refinement has a stronger impact on de-identification quality than structural preprocessing.
